hooks.name: Installed Power Capability Index
hooks.description: Indexes installed powers and limits activation to the smallest task-relevant capability.

action.prompt: Installed powers and documented routing: oando-workflow for this repository's orientation, graph/fork/database workflow, and power routing; design-system-power-builder for scaffolding a complete design-system project; nova-act for exploratory human-like browser automation; kane-cli for repeatable browser tests, screenshots, deployment smoke checks, and test-case authoring; postman for Postman collections and API resources; context7 for current official library/framework documentation; exa for broad live-web research; datadog for production observability; ltm-power for local project memory and resume/recall; cubic-code-review for AI code-review and security-review information; cloudinary for image/video asset management and transformations; supabase-hosted for Supabase/Postgres/auth/storage/RLS work. For repository orientation and architecture impact, prefer repo-map and scripts/graph-impact.mjs over external powers. Activate only the smallest relevant power, or none when no capability matches. Use MCP only for the named power's documented service and only after task-specific user need; never activate unrelated powers. Tests and gates are user-invoked only: do not load verify-and-gate or run test-like commands automatically. The block-agent-tests PreToolUse hook is unconditional because its payload cannot safely represent a trusted user-invocation exception.
